Global Fund Policy & Trends — Q3 2025
•Federal Reserve (Fed) has signaled the potential for rate cuts in 
the near term, with implications for supporting risk assets. 
•Large global fixed -income net inflows and easing cash rates 
reinforce investor sentiment toward asset allocation shifting into 
equities and infrastructure.
       Thailand Fund Policy & Trends – Q3 2025
•Bank of Thailand ( BoT) cut its policy rate from 1.75% to 1.50% in 
August 2025 and projected inflation to fall to around 0% in 
2025.
•Analysts expect further rate cuts to around 1.00% by Q1 2026, 
supported by subdued inflation and weak domestic demand.Key Investment Themes in Q3-2025
Technology & AI: Growth supported by AI, cloud, and data -center 
expansion, with strong earnings from U.S. tech leaders and 
improving momentum in China and Europe.
Global Infrastructure: Attractive outlook amid expectations of 
lower interest rates and rising demand for digital infrastructure, 
especially data centers and smart grids.
Nuclear Energy & Uranium: Long-term demand driven by data -
intensive industries, clean -energy transition, and renewed nuclear 
programs globally.
Healthcare & Life Sciences: A defensive sector with stable growth 
supported by medical innovation and aging populations.
